What should I look for in an apartment marketing agency?

Short answer

Choose an agency that already markets apartment communities, reports the actions renters take (calls, direction requests, website clicks), and works on Google Maps and AI search as well as social. The SocialDM markets more than 7,900 apartment homes across five states, and its LocalLift Weekly Pulse shows communities on the program those numbers every week.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

What to look for

01Apartment experience. Communities like yours, whether in lease up or stabilized, in similar markets.
02Reporting you can check. Numbers tied to renters taking action, each with the source and the date it runs to.
03Google and AI, not just social. Renters can now ask Google Maps and ChatGPT where to live, so your agency should watch both.
04A clear scope. What is included each month, who does the work, and how fast they reply.
Questions to ask any agencyWhich apartment communities do you market today? What will you report every week, and where does each number come from? How do you check whether Google and ChatGPT name our community? What does it take to cancel?
Red flagsGuaranteed rankings or guaranteed leases, reports that only show followers and reach, and long contracts with no way out.
FAQ

Questions we hear

Do I need one agency for social and another for Google?

Not always. One agency keeps your details, photos and voice the same everywhere, and matching facts are what Google and AI tools tend to rely on.

Should an agency guarantee results?

No. Nobody controls Google or AI rankings. Ask for clear weekly reporting instead.
